research.note: Five strategies drawn from published research, each tested on 2021-2026 data before it was scheduled. Every Sharpe behind them carries roughly +/-0.5 standard error on five years, so none of the differences between variants is statistically significant. gapfade and lateday are computed and recorded but funded at zero: the free data plan cannot serve a bar until it is 15 minutes old, which forces entries 20 minutes later than the ones that were measured, and neither edge survives that.
